summary: Linear, unconditional sequence of four steps: initialize conditional state at global unk_8AFE18 via ConditionalInit, run a subsystem step via sub_553700 passing global dword_8B8DC8, compute state flags via StateFlagComputation, then reset the conditional state at unk_8AFE18 and return its result. No guard branches. Existing analysis proposes this is a render-frame step (duplicate of sub_495020), while the LEGACY ABI name suggests audio-system init; both are unconfirmed.

operations.description: Call ConditionalInit(&unk_8AFE18): initialize the conditional/timing state stored at global unk_8AFE18 before the subsystem step.
Call sub_553700(dword_8B8DC8): run the subsystem step, passing the global dword_8B8DC8 (render device per existing analysis).
Call StateFlagComputation(0): compute internal state flags after the step.
Call ConditionalStateReset(&unk_8AFE18): reset the conditional/timing state at global unk_8AFE18.
